name: Magnum Seiba
author: Younes Aberkane
summary: Controls Tesla charging, climate, locks, navigation, security, and schedules through the Teslr integration.
starterPrompt: Show my current Tesla status and recommend the safest useful action, but wait for my approval before changing anything.
usageNote: Review every vehicle action before approving it. Confirm the intended car and never issue commands while driving.
